handedness.visual_basis: Down-the-line images show the golfer's left side closer to the target (lead side) at address and throughout the swing, indicating a right-handed stance.

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Address posture with club near the ball and no visible movement yet.
Club and hands have started moving away from the ball relative to the address frame.
Hands and club continue away; shaft rising.
Further continuation of the takeaway with hands moving upward and away.
Hands and club clearly away from the ball; backswing progressing.
Hands continuing up and back; still moving away from the ball.
Backswing position with hands rising; still away from the ball.
Hands near top region, still moving away.
Hands higher in backswing; movement away continues.
Approaching or at top of backswing; hands high and away.
Near top-of-backswing; hands still moving away or near stop.
Hands at or near top and beginning to change direction toward the ball.
Hands clearly moving back down toward the ball from the top.
Downswing with hands traveling toward the ball.
Hands continuing down toward impact zone.
Downswing sequence; hands approaching ball.
Hands and club near impact area moving toward the ball.
Hands still moving toward the ball; club approaching impact.
Frame shows body and club past typical impact location; follow-through starting.
Follow-through continuation; club and hands past impact.
Follow-through with rotation and continuation after impact.
Later follow-through frames showing continuation after strike.
Late follow-through; body rotated and finishing.
Final follow-through frame; swing completed past the ball.
